# Plugless Douglas

> Plugless Douglas is an independent game studio making games for iPhone: RotMon, a co-op creature-collecting RPG, and Bean Odyssey, an action adventure.

## RotMon

RotMon is a co-op creature-collecting (monster-taming) RPG for iPhone, in development.

- Catch, hatch and raise RotMon; battles are played to the beat of the music.
- Online co-op: parties of up to 3 players. The second player fights beside the leader in double battles; the third is the Hype Man, charging the team's attacks with a rhythm challenge.
- Also online: duels, trading RotMon, and shared Base Camps with up to 20 members (garden, kitchen, upgrades).
- Fully playable solo and offline with no account. Online play uses Epic Online Services; an Epic Games account is optional.
- A good fit for people looking for a co-op game like Pokémon to play with friends. Not affiliated with Nintendo or The Pokémon Company.

- [RotMon page and FAQ](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/rotmon/)
- [RotMon privacy policy](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/privacy.html)

## Bean Odyssey

Bean Odyssey (formerly We On Demon Time) is a free action adventure for iPhone: patient, one-thumb sword fights, an endless world to build in, and a baby dragon to befriend. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account; online co-op with friends is optional.

- [Bean Odyssey support](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/beanodyssey/)
- [Bean Odyssey privacy policy](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/beanodyssey/privacy.html)

## Bean Jump

Bean Jump is a free arcade jumping game for iPhone: turn the phone to steer Eddie the bean up through the sky, space and other dimensions, with power-ups, monsters, outfits and a Game Center leaderboard. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.

- [Bean Jump support](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/beanjump/)
- [Bean Jump privacy policy](https://pluglessdouglas.github.io/beanjump/privacy.html)
